subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A1640/26 NOTAMR A4491/25 Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2605210800  C) 2612311600  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A2145/26 (200936 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 250826 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 291225 LGACYAYC DEC 2025.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A2145/26 (200936 EUECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE
AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH THE ATS UNITS.
AS HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY NOTED IN THE PAST AND WITH THE REF (B)
291225 LGACYAYC DEC 2025 GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE TO TURKEY, PARTS
OF THE AREA MENTIONED IN TURKISH NOTAM A2145/26 (200936 EUECYIYN MAY
2026) OVERLAP AREAS OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE.
FURTHERMORE, THE TURKISH REQUEST ENTAILS LONG-TERM RESERVATION
OF AIRSPACE CONTRARY TO THE RELEVANT ICAO RECOMMENDATIONS.
MOREOVER THE REQUESTED EXERSICE AREA AFFECTS PART OF R19 AND L995
INTERNATIONAL AIRWAYS AS WELL AS DOMESTIC AIR TRAFFIC. END PART 1 OF 2
A1640/26 NOTAMR A4491/25 Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2605210800  C) 2612311600  E) CONSEQUENTLY, THE AREA AS REQUESTED IS NOT AVAILABLE.
FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE TURKISH NOTAM A2145/26 (200936 EU
ECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE TO ATHINAI FIR. END PART 2 OF 2
